serviceDescription:
SecureIT is a FedRAMP Recognized Independent Assessor, accredited by A2LA to ISO/IEC 17020. Founded in 2001 and FedRAMP recognized since October 2013, SecureIT assesses cloud service offerings across certification Classes A through D, under both FedRAMP 20x and Rev5.

**Track record.** SecureIT has performed FedRAMP assessments continuously since 2013. Our current assessment customers are public on the Clients tab of this listing and include Class D assessments. We have assessed at every class level the program has offered and have worked with our clients from initial certification through multiple years of ongoing assessment.

**Technical depth.** Our senior assessors routinely evaluate both legacy and modern cloud architectures: serverless, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and multi-cloud and hybrid deployments across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Under 20x that includes reviewing the code behind your automated Key Security Indicator validations, not simply accepting their output. Our seasoned team communicates effectively with client engineers and architects, and they hold CISSP, CISA, CCSK, OSCP, AWS Certified Security, Azure Security Engineer, and/or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer credentials.

**Rev5, 20x, CR26.** Under Rev5 we perform initial and ongoing certification assessments at Classes B, C, and D, annual and significant change assessments, penetration and red team testing, and continuous monitoring validation, and we produce traditional assessment artifacts when an agency authorizing official asks for them. Under 20x we verify and validate FedRAMP Practices against Key Security Indicators, assess the automated validations behind them, and support your Security Decision Record and Certification Package Overview. Under CR26 every requirement we test traces to a published FedRAMP rule, and we do not enforce anything that is not explicitly required.

**How we work.** You get named project leads and senior assessors, not a rotating bench. We tell you what we need up front, we answer questions in hours rather than days, and we raise issues when we find them instead of saving them for the report. We understand that an assessment is a disruption to your core business, so we work diligently to make sure that the impact is minimized.

**Independence.** Consistent with REC-IAS-SEP, SecureIT does not perform a FedRAMP independent assessment of a cloud service offering within two years of supplying advisory or consulting services for that offering. Our assessment practice operates under separate leadership and separate personnel from our advisory practice. Our advisory offerings are listed separately in the Marketplace.
